references.text: The principle of proportional distribution based on the size of the tribe - the large tribe receives more, the small one less
The same principle of distributing land according to the size of the tribe is repeated here
The context for this verse - the Levites are to receive cities from the inheritance of the children of Israel
The fulfillment of this commandment - the children of Israel gave the Levites cities from their inheritance
Total number of Levitical cities given by the various tribes
The Levites had no inheritance in the land, so they were to receive cities from the other tribes
